Teamwork & Reliability A dependable presence on shift — the team trusts you to show up, follow process and share knowledge.   Continuous Improvement Proactively spots inefficiencies and suggests better ways to work — the NOC keeps getting better. Career Pathway Progression opportunities to Senior NOC Analyst and L2/L3 Network Engineering roles.   Vendor Training On-the-job learning plus supported study toward relevant certifications.   Meaningful Work Your work keeps NZ's emergency services and utilities running — it matters.   Tight-Knit Team A supportive, experienced team that has your back on every shift.   Modern Tooling Current-generation monitoring, ITSM and comms platforms. Send CV and Cover Letter to recruitment@vital.co.nz
